title: Error-summary contract: top-of-page summary with skip links per failed field, aria-invalid on the field, and focus moved to the summary heading on submit failure
description: On submit refusal the step renders a top-of-page error summary region carrying a heading and one skip link per failed field. Each skip link's target is a focusable field element; the field carries aria-invalid="true" while unresolved and aria-describedby pointing at the field-level error message. On submit failure the client moves focus to the summary heading so a screen-reader user hears the error class and can walk the skip links; visual users see the heading anchor scroll into view. The summary and per-field bindings anchor on TAC-2502 (error-summary contract). Per WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1 Error Identification and SC 3.3.3 Error Suggestion.
rationale: Per the application-core specification section 5.3, REQ 3.
